description.value: Sushi Bar Nagomi is an authentic Japanese sushi restaurant on BC's Sunshine Coast, opened in 2008 by Tokyo-trained chef Hiro Funaki who settled in Gibsons for its natural beauty and community spirit. The restaurant occupies the ground floor of a beloved 1945 heritage building known locally as 'The Pink House' in Gibsons Landing, with an interior influenced by Japanese architectural sensibility. The menu emphasizes freshness and technique — from hand-prepared sushi rice to in-house fish preparation — alongside a curated selection of premium sake.
